note: The notice board on Home (Figures): tips, and what the latest big update brought. Software file, replaced by updates; never user data. Text: **bold**, *italic*, `key`; {mod} and {alt} become Ctrl / Alt (Cmd / Option on a Mac). action: one of the names the editor knows (see CLAUDE.md, Home). picture: a path inside notices/ or brand/, or an inline <svg>. icon: a glyph name or an icon key. desk: true = the tip names keys or right-click and is left out on phones and touch screens.

tips.text: Press `Shift` `C` to add a citation: paste a reference exported from Zotero, EndNote, Mendeley or PubMed.
Hold `{alt}` while you drag to drag a copy of the selection; its animations come along.
`{mod}` `O` (or the house button) opens **Home**, the page of all your figures.
`Shift` `A` opens the animation sidebar: select an element, then pick an entrance, an exit or a motion path.
`F5` presents from the first slide, `Shift` `F5` from the slide you are on; `V` opens the presenter view.
Add panel → Chemistry → **Structure**: type a SMILES such as c1ccccc1 in its panel and the skeletal formula draws itself.
`{mod}` `Shift` `C` copies the selection as a picture, ready to paste into PowerPoint, Keynote or Word.
Page panel → **Check colors** finds text with too little contrast and colors that look alike with color-vision deficiency.
Pick a journal column under **Size** in the Export dialog (`{mod}` `E`): the smallest text is then checked in pt.
Right-click an icon → **Convert to editable parts** to recolor, move or delete its pieces.
Right-click → **Save as icon…** keeps a selection in *My icons* in the Add panel, for every figure.
Select two or more elements and press **Connect**: the arrows follow them when they move.
`Shift` `X` crops the selected element: drag the handles inward, then press `Enter`.
The Add panel’s search understands synonyms, plurals, British spellings and small typos.
Press `/` to jump to the Add panel’s search; `↓` and `Enter` add what it found.
In any text, H_2O gives a subscript and x^2 a superscript; `{mod}` `B` and `{mod}` `I` make bold and italic.
`Shift` `1` fits the page in the window, `Shift` `2` the selection; `{mod}` + wheel zooms toward the pointer.
Hold `Space` and drag, or drag with the middle mouse button, to pan the view.
Leave notes with **+ Comment**: an AI assistant working with SiliCoDraw can read them and reply.
Select the panels of a multi-panel figure and press **Label panels**: a, b, c in reading order.
File ▾ → **Version history** brings back an earlier state of a figure (a snapshot at most every 5 minutes).
A microscope TIFF dropped on the canvas is stored as PNG, with 16-bit brightness stretched to fit.
The gear button (**Appearance**) sets a dark theme, the interface style, larger text and compact spacing.
On Home, select several figures and choose **Export…** to export them all at once.
`{mod}` `D` duplicates the selection, `{mod}` `G` groups it.
Species names such as *C. elegans* and *E. coli* are set in italics by themselves.
A **Section box** holds its own text and wraps it to its width: double-click it to type.
`Tab` on the canvas selects the next element, `Shift` `Tab` the one before.
The pencil button starts **Sketch** mode: draw a rough idea, add notes, then let your AI build it.

news.title: Home, and start where you left off
news.text: Every figure with a picture, search, archive and trash; SiliCoDraw opens where you left off.

news.title: The animation sidebar
news.text: Entrances, exits and motion paths in one place, played on the canvas and kept in PowerPoint.

news.title: Present, with Fade and Push
news.text: A slideshow with a presenter view, transitions and a background color for each slide.

news.title: Citations from Zotero and EndNote
news.text: Paste or drop RIS, BibTeX, EndNote or PubMed exports, many references at once.

news.title: Environmental microbiology icons
news.text: Methanogens, biofilms, soil profiles, the nitrogen cycle, wastewater plants and more.

news.title: Import more icons
news.text: Open repositories such as SciDraw, NIH BioArt and BioDraws, with a credit line where asked.

news.title: New presentation and Import on Home
news.text: Start a file with slides right from Home, or bring in figures, folders and .zip backups.

news.title: The Cite button
news.text: The quotation-mark button in the top bar adds a citation to the figure.

news.title: Back to original position
news.text: A motion path that brings an element back in a straight line from where its earlier path left it.

news.title: Pasted elements keep their animations
news.text: Copy, Duplicate or {alt}-drag an animated element: its animations come along.

news.title: Crop
news.text: Crop a picture, an icon, a chart or a shape; PowerPoint keeps a picture’s crop.

news.title: A new app icon
news.text: The Co palette mark on a silicon element tile, in the browser tab and on the desktop.

news.title: Colors in this icon
news.text: Recolor each part of a repository icon; its shades follow, so the shading stays.
